notes: Stories created for Provider Search backend feature with full coverage: schema, logic, API, tests, integration.

stories.title: Define Provider Search Input/Output Schema
stories.description: Define Pydantic models for provider search requests and responses including query text, location filters, specialty codes (NUCC), and ranked provider results.

stories.title: Implement Core Provider Search Logic
stories.description: Implement vector search with taxonomy fallback using provider_search_service including embedding lookup, MongoDB Atlas vector search, NUCC taxonomy mapping, and ranking logic.

stories.title: Specialty Identification and Query Expansion
stories.description: Implement specialty extraction using dual pipeline (regex + vector) and AI query expansion, mapping results to NUCC codes for downstream search.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade
stories.description: Integrate provider search logic into FindCareFacade and expose as tool-callable function through tool_router with validated inputs and structured outputs.

stories.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for search logic and specialty mapping plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from tool_router through facade to MongoDB search.
